status: Archero-style two-layer progression selected by owner on 24 October 2026. Numerical values and adaptations remain a simulation/playtest candidate.

targets.end: Death only. No time or level cap; observation horizons censor survivors.

damage.effect: Add 5% of each unmodified original weapon damage template per rank; maximum +25%. Run modifiers apply afterwards.

hull.effect: Add 6 starting and maximum hull per rank; maximum +30.

shield.effect: Add 4 starting and maximum shield per rank; maximum +20. No permanent recharge-speed increase.

capture.effect: Add 3% base biological capture rate per rank; maximum +15%. No additional beam or vehicle capture-rate bonus.

permanent.purchase_policy_for_simulation: Buy the lowest-rank affordable track; ties follow a declared account preference. Spend between runs only. Total cost to cap four tracks is 6,000 credits.

credits.formula: For runs lasting at least 30 active seconds: floor(active seconds/8) + floor(score/5) + 2*(jeep kills + tank kills + vehicle captures) + 5*boss kills. No entry fee or reward loss on death.
credits.bonus: Optional completed credit ad grants floor(base run credits / 2) extra credits: +50%, once. No extra XP or achievement progress. Hide the offer when all remaining permanent upgrades are affordable. A double-credit scenario is a comparison only.

loadout: No manual blueprint loadout. Nine starter blueprints, including Beam Splitter, are eligible at a fresh account. Heavy Winch, Arc Coil and Phase Drive join through their existing achievements. Twelve hardware families remain, with six installed slots and three ranks. Every choice remains random; no guaranteed or preinstalled Beam Splitter.

revive.clear: Clear ordinary active enemies/projectiles for breathing room; retain bosses, active run time, XP and build. Full native geometry remains to be tested.
revive.unavailable: Declining or unavailable ads immediately allow ordinary results/restart. No reward is granted for an incomplete or failed ad.

monetisation.first_playable: Use local placement test doubles; no live SDK or billing integration in this planning pass.
launch_candidate: one optional rewarded revive per eligible run
excluded: ads during active play or level-up choices
monetisation.scenario_note: Thirty seconds is an assumed wall-clock cost per completed ad, not measured inventory, conversion, fill or revenue. All-ad scenarios are upper-bound exposure cases.

director.note: Run-time-based escalation shared by every account. No scaling to permanent power, player level, spending, ad choice or losing streak. Numerical assumptions remain uncalibrated.

implementation_order: Portable UFO run: movement, automatic lasers, capture, military attacks, death/restart and paused three-card level-ups with exact gains.
Level curve and active-time director; earned evolutions and visible next-sector/record goals. No forced death time or power-matching enemy scaling.
One Hangar screen: Research Credits, four capped permanent tracks and next rank cost; purchases are optional before immediate retry.
Free blueprint achievements: new cards join later random draws automatically. Keep prerequisites, module caps and exact per-pick descriptions.
Atomic account/reward checkpoint settlement and recovery. Run upgrades reset; credits, Hangar ranks, unlocks and records persist.
Local revive/+50% credit placement test doubles, then repeated human/device tests. Defer live ads, billing and additional progression systems until the loop is measured.
supersedes: short-run-progression.json, especially its manual ten-blueprint loadout. Earlier results remain historical evidence.

adopt: simple mobile movement with automatic attacks
three temporary skill choices at each earned level
earned permanent starting-power improvements between runs
equipment and character unlocks that motivate future attempts
adapt: Endless UFO runner, ending on death; no room/mission completion requirement.
Lasers continue to fire while moving. No stationary-fire requirement is adopted.
Four capped Hangar tracks instead of an equipment inventory, merging, pets or multiple upgrade currencies.
All unlocked blueprints automatically enter the draw pool; no manual loadout screen.
Biological capture is an active objective alongside military combat.

sectors.rule: Endless distance/sector records give short goals. Finishing a sector does not reset the ship, pause for a shop, restart difficulty or force a run ending. No sector bonus is added in this experiment.

eligibility_rule: Unlocked blueprints join the automatic pool, subject to visible run prerequisites. Heavy Winch waits for Beam Splitter II and Laser Array I; Arc Coil waits for Laser Array I. Beam Splitter has no achievement or run prerequisite. Phase Drive retains its achievement. Removed hardware does not enter offers or achievement lists.
